title: Continuation and missing work
summary: Continue from dev5 by live-qualifying structured flow-control semantics, then remove native lifetime races and add external COTS interoperability without leaking QUIC mechanics above the provider boundary.
invariants: First rerun the complete ooRexx 5.3.0 r13196/native qualification for dev5.
Harden native handle lifetime so close cannot free a connection/stream while another native operation holds a raw pointer.
Serialize or otherwise prove safe concurrent OpenSSL access to a connection and its child streams before claiming thread-safe use.
Add external COTS QUIC interoperability evidence; loopback alone is not cross-implementation proof.
Keep MU/MI internode carrier authority with the selected estate transport; do not silently substitute QUIC for XTP.
Do not move HTTP/3 semantics into the socket provider.
